verdict.rationale: Inline completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair axis for an AI coding assistant, but the evidence only documents chat-driven edits and a watch mode that acts on explicit 'AI!' comments when a file is saved. That is an adjacent, comment-triggered editing workflow, not completions or next-edit suggestions offered as you type.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
